vsm1.7:68.2: ‘‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ pariyattidhammassa ceva navavidhassa ca lokuttaradhammassa guṇā anussaritabbā.
vsm1.7:69.1: Svākkhātoti imasmiṃ hi pade pariyattidhammopi saṅgahaṃ gacchati,
vsm1.7:69.6: Yañhi bhagavā ekagāthampi deseti, sā samantabhaddakattā dhammassa paṭhamapādena ādikalyāṇā,
vsm1.7:69.16: veneyyānaṃ anurūpato atthassa aviparītatāya ca hetudāharaṇayuttato ca majjhekalyāṇaṃ,
vsm1.7:70.1: Sakalopi sāsanadhammo attano atthabhūtena sīlena ādikalyāṇo,
vsm1.7:70.10: Taṃ sutvā tathatthāya paṭipannena adhigantabbāya abhisambodhiyā vā ādikalyāṇo,
vsm1.7:71.1: Suyyamāno cesa nīvaraṇavikkhambhanato savanenapi kalyāṇameva āvahatīti ādikalyāṇo,
vsm1.7:72.1: Yaṃ panesa bhagavā dhammaṃ desento sāsanabrahmacariyaṃ maggabrahmacariyañca pakāseti nānānayehi dīpeti,
vsm1.7:73.8: Yathā hi aññatitthiyānaṃ dhammassa attho vipallāsamāpajjati,
vsm1.7:73.11: Tena te durakkhātadhammāyeva honti, na tathā bhagavato dhammassa attho vipallāsamāpajjati.
vsm1.7:73.12: Ime dhammā antarāyikā, ime dhammā niyyānikāti evaṃ vuttadhammānaṃ tathābhāvānatikkamanatoti.
vsm1.7:74.1: Lokuttaradhammo pana nibbānānurūpāya paṭipattiyā paṭipadānurūpassa ca nibbānassa akkhātattā svākkhāto.
vsm1.7:74.2: Yathāha – ‘‘supaññattā kho pana tena bhagavatā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā saṃsandati nibbānañca paṭipadā ca.
vsm1.7:74.3: Seyyathāpi nāma gaṅgodakaṃ yamunodakena saṃsandati sameti,
vsm1.7:74.4: evameva supaññattā (dī. ni. 2.296) tena bhagavatā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā saṃsandati nibbānañca paṭipadā cā’’ti.
vsm1.7:75.1: Ariyamaggo cettha antadvayaṃ anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadābhūtova
vsm1.7:76.1: Sandiṭṭhikoti ettha pana ariyamaggo tāva attano santāne rāgādīnaṃ abhāvaṃ karontena ariyapuggalena sāmaṃ daṭṭhabboti sandiṭṭhiko.
vsm1.7:76.2: Yathāha –‘‘ratto kho, brāhmaṇa, rāgena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto
vsm1.7:76.3: attabyābādhāyapi ceteti, parabyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti.
vsm1.7:76.5: Rāge pahīne neva attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti,
vsm1.7:76.7: Evampi kho, brāhmaṇa, sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hotī’’ti(a. ni. 3.54).
vsm1.7:77.1: Apica navavidhopi lokuttaradhammo yena yena adhigato hoti, tena tena parasaddhāya gantabbataṃ hitvā paccavekkhaṇañāṇena sayaṃ daṭṭhabboti sandiṭṭhiko.
vsm1.7:78.6: Tasmā yathā rathena jayatīti rathiko, evaṃ navavidhopi lokuttaradhammo sandiṭṭhiyā jayatīti sandiṭṭhiko.
vsm1.7:80.1: Attano phaladānaṃ sandhāya nāssa kāloti akālo.
vsm1.7:80.3: Na pañcāhasattāhādibhedaṃ kālaṃ khepetvā phalaṃ deti,
vsm1.7:80.4: attano pana pavattisamanantarameva phaladoti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:81.1: Atha vā attano phaladāne pakaṭṭho kālo patto assāti kāliko.
vsm1.7:81.4: Ayaṃ pana samanantaraphalattā na kālikoti akāliko.
vsm1.7:82.1: ‘‘Ehi passa imaṃ dhamma’’nti evaṃ pavattaṃ ehipassavidhiṃ arahatīti ehipassiko.
vsm1.7:82.4: Rittamuṭṭhiyaṃ hi hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā atthīti vatvāpi ‘‘ehi passa ima’’nti na sakkā vattuṃ.
vsm1.7:82.7: Vijjamānampi ca gūthaṃ vā muttaṃ vā
vsm1.7:82.8: manuññabhāvappakāsanena cittasampahaṃsanatthaṃ ‘‘ehi passa ima’’nti na sakkā vattuṃ.
vsm1.7:82.9: Apica kho pana tiṇehi vā paṇṇehi vā paṭicchādetabbameva hoti.
vsm1.7:82.12: Ayaṃ pana navavidhopi lokuttaradhammo sabhāvatova vijjamāno
vsm1.7:82.15: Tasmā vijjamānattā parisuddhattā ca ehipassavidhiṃ arahatīti ehipassiko.
vsm1.7:83.3: ādittaṃ celaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā ajjhupekkhitvāpi bhāvanāvasena attano citte upanayanaṃ arahatīti opanayiko. Opanayikova opaneyyiko.
vsm1.7:83.5: Asaṅkhate pana attano cittena upanayanaṃ arahatīti opaneyyiko.
vsm1.7:84.1: Atha vā nibbānaṃ upanetīti ariyamaggo upaneyyo.
vsm1.7:85.2: sabbehipi ugghaṭitaññūādīhi viññūhi attani attani veditabbo
vsm1.7:85.3: ‘‘bhāvito me maggo, adhigataṃ phalaṃ, sacchikato nirodho’’ti.
vsm1.7:85.4: Na hi upajjhāyena bhāvitena maggena saddhivihārikassa kilesā pahīyanti,
vsm1.7:85.7: Tasmā na esa parassa sīse ābharaṇaṃ viya daṭṭhabbo,
vsm1.7:86.6: Yo ca ehipassiko, so nāma opaneyyiko hotīti.
vsm1.7:87.2: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:87.3: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:87.4: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbhāti (a. ni. 6.10)
vsm1.7:87.9: Tadetaṃ dhammaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā dhammānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.7:88.2: evaṃ opaneyyikassa dhammassa desetāraṃ imināpaṅgena samannāgataṃ satthāraṃ neva atītaṃse samanupassāmi,
vsm1.7:88.4: evaṃ dhammaguṇadassaneneva satthari sagāravo hoti sappatisso.
